Description

Positive dimensions and nonnegative contextual indices.

Construction and access are pure. Window-link indices and pane indices have distinct types; neither substitutes for an entity ID. A constructor checks the mathematical domain, while command-specific limits belong at the operation boundary. Use mkDimension, mkWindowIndex and mkPaneIndex to validate input; their accessors return mathematical integers. Entity identifiers belong to LibTmux.Id.

>>> fmap dimensionValue (mkDimension 120)
Right 120
>>> mkDimension 0
Left (NonPositiveDimension 0)

data Dimension Source #

Positive cells, constructed with mkDimension. Command and field limits are checked separately. Compare dimensions directly or use dimensionValue with an integer literal.

data WindowIndex Source #

Nonnegative index of a window link within a session, not a physical window ID. Construct with mkWindowIndex; read with windowIndexValue.
